provenance.label: New Haven coffee shops near campus
provenance.detail: Street addresses are the businesses' published locations. Coordinates are geocodes of those addresses, not surveyed entrances. Seat counts are unknown — do not treat walkingMinutes here as capacity.

shops.name: Common Grounds
shops.description: Independent cafe on York Street in the Broadway shops. Espresso, pastries, two-tops and a window bar. Wifi and some outlets. Seat count is not published.

shops.name: Atticus Bookstore Cafe
shops.description: Bookstore cafe on Chapel Street across from the Yale University Art Gallery. Counter seating and a communal table. Seat count is not published.

shops.name: Book Trader Cafe
shops.description: Used-bookstore cafe on Chapel Street with indoor tables and a courtyard when it is warm. Seat count is not published.

shops.name: Blue State Coffee
shops.description: Cafe on Broadway near York. Published address 84 Broadway. Seat count is not published.

shops.name: Willoughby's Coffee & Tea
shops.description: Coffee roaster on Church Street. Published address 258 Church St. Seat count is not published.

shops.name: Koffee?
shops.description: Cafe on Audubon Street. Published address 104 Audubon St. Seat count is not published.
